The '''Ovoni''' were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Otavon XII]].

They opposed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its early days. They succeeded in destroying [[Tremor Base]], an [[Imperial Outpost]] established for the construction of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] on Otavon XII.
